implementation_issues.description: CV_FORECAST is called a coefficient of variation without formula or zero/negative-mean rule; STDEV/MEANEST is only a candidate.
DOWN_REV has conflicting endpoints: before q announcement in prose, before q ends in Table 4 note.
ΔROE uses q−4 in prose and q−1 in Table 4 note; q−4 is used for maximum temporal coverage while retaining the conflict.
Table 5 prints v_it inside the exponential, while Equation (2) and Appendix omit it.
The paper identifies both Compustat and I/B/E/S but omits its historical issuer crosswalk, date/tie policy and auditor company-key join. Local link tables are candidates only.
Big 5 classification requires mapping historical auditor names/keys and carrying auditor status to each quarter.
Winsorization is specified at both 1st-percentile tails, but ties, missing values and pooled versus period-specific cutoffs are not stated.
Current local I/B/E/S products do not establish the precise 1993–1999 historical vintage or EPS adjustment state; the paper notes actual-EPS calculation differences around its sample boundary.
